task: Make the SAA website responsive across mobile (~375px), tablet (~768px), and desktop (1440px) without changing the existing desktop appearance.
acceptanceCriteria: No horizontal scroll at 375, 768, and 1440px on any page
Primary navigation reachable on mobile via hamburger
All interactive overlays stay within the viewport
No regression in existing test suite; typecheck and lint clean
blastRadius: UI/layout only: Tailwind breakpoint classes plus one new client-side mobile-nav component. No data models, APIs, auth, or business logic touched.
contracts: No API or data-contract changes. Added i18n key nav.menu to en.json and vi.json (additive).
